propositions: Repository demonstrates mature governance with shrink-only ratchets, comprehensive linting, and strong test tiering; however 87 source modules exceed 500-LOC target and 206 functions exceed complexity 15, with hotspots in orchestration functions like compute() and import_tickets()

Mypy passes all 440 source modules but diagnostic --disallow-untyped-defs run found 687 errors; only rebar.graph and rebar.grounding enforce strict typing, requiring package-by-package strictness expansion

Documentation routes incorrectly (MCP entry points), contains contradicted guidance (assignee examples require email/accountId not bare handles), and outdated workflow descriptions; drift checks needed

Test suite is strong (8,748+ test functions, 83.86% coverage, excellent isolation/fixture reuse) but Python 3.11 xdist worker flakiness in test_opcert_service_app.py causes spurious Verified-1 and 8-24min rerun latency

Two test-environment assumptions fail: test_help_overview_coverage.py assumes all src/rebar files are UTF-8 (breaks on Mach-O binary), test_attestation_signing.py assumes full Git history (fails on shallow clones)
